raw_segments.text: See, Father, what first fruits on earth are sprung from thy implanted grace in man?
These sighs and prayers, which in this golden censer mixed with incense, I thy priest before
Fruits of more pleasing savour from thy seed sown with contrition in his heart, than those
which, his own hand menuring, all the trees of paradise could have produced, ere fallen
Now therefore, bend thine ear to supplication.
